{{Quote|The Stun Master certainly made my job a lot easier.|[[Lowwel]]|<ref name="GFT" />}}
The '''CS-12 Stun Master''' was a [[contact stunner]] sold by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] as a personal protection device. Due to its innocuous appearance and small size&mdash;only fifteen [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] long and five centimeters in diameter&mdash;it was easily [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] past authorities. It required an energy cell to be effective.
